text:
Artturi Lehkonen scored the goal that won Colorado the 2022 Stanley Cup, and he's never been a player who needed the spotlight. He has it now: 12 goals in 17 games, eight of them in his last ten.

That run is partly earned. He's put up 5.3 expected goals on his own shots over those ten games (the quality of his chances), against 3.7 usual, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 90th percentile among forwards in chances from the home plate in front of the net last season. But he's shooting 33%, after 14% last season, and Colorado has scored 7.7 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. Evolving-Hockey also notes he plays with some of the strongest teammates in the league, which helps. The honest read: a smart net-front winger on a great team, in a hot patch that will cool. Our projection has 27 to 42 more goals.
headline: Lehkonen's hot start, and how hot it really is
